title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging enhancements
author: Jordan Li
description:
Summary: Enforce RBAC v2 KMS region pinning at policy evaluation time and add structured audit logging for policy decisions and KMS-residency related operations. Motivation: customers on Dedicated/Private deployments require strong guarantees that keys and operations remain within pinned regions and that any policy violations are auditable. This PR implements enforcement toggles, improves audit fidelity for RBAC/KMS interactions, and provides a migration path for existing RBAC v2 policies.

What changed: 1) Enforcement: rbac policy engine now understands a 'kms_region_pin' constraint and will reject requests that attempt KMS operations outside allowed regions when enforcement mode is enabled. Enforcement is opt-in via cluster config (rbac.v2.enforcement=true). 2) Audit logging: introduce structured audit events for RBAC policy evaluation outcomes (allowed/denied/filtered) with KMS context fields (key_id, key_region, requesting_principal, policy_id, reason). Events are emitted to the existing audit pipeline and include a stable event_type 'rbac.v2.kms_evaluation'. 3) Migration: migration script escalates legacy region residency annotations into rbac v2 constraints where possible and emits a migration report. 4) Tests & CI: add unit and integration tests that exercise permissive/audit/enforce modes and region-mismatched KMS requests. 5) Docs: new docs page describing policy examples, rollout recommendations, and troubleshooting tips.

Checklist: - [x] Implementation of kms region pinning enforcement in policy manager - [x] Structured audit events and schema docs - [x] Migration script + dry-run report mode - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Docs updated - [x] Security review and SCA scan passed

Testing notes: Ran full unit and integration suite. Integration initially failed on a flaky mock KMS client; fixed by increasing mock latency tolerance and adding a retry in the test harness. Load-tested enforcement path to ensure <1ms median policy eval overhead. Verified audit events appear in dev audit pipeline and include expected fields.

Rollout plan: Default install remains audit-only. We will ship with enforcement disabled; customers can opt-in via config. After 2 weeks of opt-ins and monitoring, we'll coordinate with SRE to flip enforcement in selected Dedicated clusters following a canary rollout. Migration script should be run in dry-run first and operators must review migration report before apply.

Related: ENG-4589 (design doc), SUP-1245 (customer support case), pr-203500 (prior KMS residency work).

release_notes:
- Enforceable KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 policies (opt-in via rbac.v2.enforcement)
- Structured audit events for RBAC KMS evaluations (event_type: rbac.v2.kms_evaluation)
- Migration script to convert legacy residency annotations to RBAC v2 constraints (dry-run available)
- Docs and examples for policy authoring and rollout
notes: This PR is part of a multi-PR rollout: follow-ups will add console UI hooks, policy editor validations, and per-tenant residency dashboards. Operators should run migration dry-run and review report before enabling enforcement.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: false positives causing denied KMS operations for customers. Mitigation: default to audit-only, dry-run migration, and canary rollout with explicit operator opt-in.
